attributes.board_name: Ohio Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy, and Athletic Trainers Board – Physical Therapy Section

rules.accepted_credit_types: Ohio-approved CE: courses must carry an Ohio approval number (reviewed by the Ohio Physical Therapy Association); academic coursework in a CAPTE entry-level or tDPT program counts without an approval number (15 contact hours per semester credit, 10 per quarter credit). Clinical instruction by APTA-credentialed CIs: 1 contact hour per 80 hours (max 12 per cycle). Mentoring in an APTA-accredited residency/fellowship: 1 contact hour per 3 hours (max 12).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: no continuing education and no JAM required.
rules.audit_note: Certificates are not submitted at renewal; keep them at least two years. A random sample of renewing licensees is audited after each renewal period (OAC 4755:2-3-01). CE waiver/extension requests are filed in eLicense.

topics.who: Ohio Jurisprudence Assessment Module (JAM, via FSBPT) every renewal cycle; counts as 2 of the 24 hours

rules.notes: PT licenses expire January 31 of even-numbered years; renewal opens November 1; no late renewal. 24 hours includes the 2-hour JAM.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Ohio-approved CE with an Ohio approval number (OPTA review); clinical instruction by APTA-credentialed Level I CIs: 1 contact hour per 80 hours (max 6 per cycle).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: no continuing education and no JAM required.
rules.audit_note: Certificates are not submitted at renewal; keep them at least two years. Random post-renewal audit.

topics.who: Ohio Jurisprudence Assessment Module (JAM) every renewal cycle; counts as 2 of the 12 hours

rules.notes: PTA licenses expire January 31 of odd-numbered years; renewal opens November 1; no late renewal. 12 hours includes the 2-hour JAM.
